title: Chatterbox speech
description: Local text to speech with Resemble AI's Chatterbox in its default voice (no voice cloning). A 3.8 s line rendered in 60 s on RTX 4090 including the first model download.

requirements.name: FL_ChatterboxTTS
requirements.instructions: Install the ComfyUI_Fill-ChatterBox node pack (MIT) with its requirements into ComfyUI's own Python (python -s -m pip install -r requirements.txt joblib).

requirements.name: SaveAudio
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version providing SaveAudio.

evidence: 2026-10-24: direct native run produced comfyfield-tts-test_00001.flac, 3.76 s, FLAC mono 24 kHz, in 60 s including the first download of ResembleAI/chatterbox (about 3.2 GB) to models/chatterbox on G:.

licenses.software: ComfyUI core: GPL-3.0. ComfyUI_Fill-ChatterBox: MIT (declared in its README). Integration license follows this repository.
